question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Stretch
solution:
```html

The correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. **Lessen**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Stretch"** means to make something longer or wider by pulling it. (खींचना)
 
 
• **Example: **He tried to stretch the elastic band as far as it would go.
 
 
 
• **"Lessen"** refers to making something smaller in amount, degree, or importance. (कम करना)
 
 
• **Example: **The new measures are intended to lessen the impact of the economic crisis.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Stretch'** is **'Lessen'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. **Lessen**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Scope** (दायरा): The extent of the area or subject matter that something deals with or to which it is relevant.
 
 
• **Example:** The scope of the project was enormous, covering several key areas.
 
 
 
• **Scale** (पैमाना): The size or level of something, especially in comparison to something else.
 
 
• **Example: **The scale of the operation was much larger than initially planned.
 
 
 
• **Range** (सीमा): The area of variation between upper and lower limits on a particular scale.
 
 
• **Example:** The product offers a wide range of features to its users.
```
